fields.statement: A project's web API (the read-only handler a project's web UI reads through) reads only that project: roadmap with all=true returns every change set of the project it serves and never widens to the root's other projects; the CLI's rhiza roadmap --all keeps widening across the root
fields.wording: Scope the web API to its project, chosen by the planner in an autonomous run

fields.acceptance: A Go test in internal/api (beside web_root_test.go) registers two initialised projects under one root, each with its own milestone and change sets, serves WebRootHandler, GETs /p/<a>/roadmap and /p/<b>/roadmap and asserts each page lists its own project's change sets and milestone and none of the other's; it also GETs /p/<a>/api/roadmap?all=true and asserts every returned change set is project a's. go test -trimpath ./internal/api/... ./internal/web/... passes, and the existing roadmap --all testscripts still widen across the root (go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/.*roadmap.*')
fields.statement: Under a Rhiza root, each project's web roadmap (/p/<project>/roadmap) and change set pages list only that project's milestones and change sets, never another registered project's
